tools.name: hr-operations_employee-document-extract
tools.description: Read employee records and labeled document lines supplied by the caller. Dates, roles, and document types are returned as supplied. Document numbers are masked. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/hr-operations/employee-document-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: hr-operations_employee-record-validate
tools.description: Compare employee records with the required fields supplied by the caller, and report an end date that falls before the start date. No legal requirement is added. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/hr-operations/employee-record-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: hr-operations_employee-policy-acknowledgement-check
tools.description: Match supplied acknowledgements to supplied policies by policy id. An acknowledgement dated before the policy date is stale. This is not a compliance determination. tools.name: hr-operations_employee-offboarding-checklist
tools.description: Build an offboarding checklist only from supplied offboarding policies. A task is met only by a supplied completion record. Access is not changed. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/hr-operations/employee-offboarding-checklist. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: hr-operations_job-role-description-compare
tools.description: Compare Duty lines in a role description with Duty lines supplied for an employee. Unlabeled prose is not a duty. The comparison is not an employment decision. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/hr-operations/job-role-description-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.description: Compare supplied expiry dates with a supplied as-of date. A document is due only inside the supplied day window. No date is invented when the as-of date is missing. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "hr-operations" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hr-operations_employee-document-extract, hr-operations_employee-policy-acknowledgement-check, hr-operations_workforce-document-expiry-check · Private data: hr-operations_employee-document-extract, hr-operations_employee-record-validate, hr-operations_employee-onboarding-checklist, hr-operations_employee-offboarding-checklist, hr-operations_workforce-document-expiry-check, hr-operations_record-completeness-report · Public sink: hr-operations_employee-document-extract, hr-operations_employee-record-validate, hr-operations_employee-policy-acknowledgement-check, hr-operations_employee-onboarding-checklist, hr-operations_employee-offboarding-checklist, hr-operations_job-role-description-compare, hr-operations_workforce-document-expiry-check, hr-operations_record-completeness-report · Destructive: hr-operations_employee-document-extract, hr-operations_employee-record-validate, hr-operations_employee-policy-acknowledgement-check, hr-operations_employee-onboarding-checklist, hr-operations_employee-offboarding-checklist, hr-operations_job-role-description-compare, hr-operations_workforce-document-expiry-check, hr-operations_record-completeness-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
